subject: PoC deployment pathing: hosted vs dedicated vs private VPC — action plan and next steps
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Clara Wu <clara.wu@nimblehealth.com>
Cc: stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: PoC deployment pathing: hosted vs dedicated vs private VPC — action plan and next steps

Hi Clara —

Great to meet earlier. Quick recap from our discovery and the options I promised to put into one note so we can align on the trial path:

1) High-level ask we heard from your side:
- Evaluate inference performance and compliance posture for PHI-bearing requests (redacted logs, KMS integration).
- Confirm estimated unit costs and latency at 99th pct for primary endpoints.
- Validate model quality on your prompt set.

2) Deployment modes (trade-offs we discussed):
- Hosted API (fastest): 1–2 week trial, no infra footprint, best for trying functionality and perf baselines. No KMS/HSM by default; we can pseudo-isolate data via scoped tenancy.
- Dedicated capacity (reserved): 3–4 week PoC to exercise throughput at scale, predictable latency, can add stricter retention controls. Requires SLA/commit agreement.
- Private VPC / On-prem: 6–8+ week engagement (network setup, KMS/HSM integration, audit evidence), highest compliance and data isolation.

3) Proposed PoC approach (recommended given PHI):
- Start with a short Hosted API baseline (1 week) to validate model quality and token economics.
- Parallel security scoping: your security + our trust team kick off to assess VPC/KMS needs.
- If scoping confirms need, pivot to Private VPC PoC with a focused infra checklist and a 4–6 week timeline for integration.

4) Success criteria (draft — please edit):
- Latency: median < 120ms, p99 < 400ms for 512-token workloads.
- Cost: estimated token cost within 15% of our baseline projection.
- Security controls: KMS wrap for stored artifacts, audit log access, and SOC 2 artifacts accepted by your security team.
- Model quality: pass your 50-shot prompt suite with >= 92% quality score.

Next steps I propose:
- Clara: confirm whether your security team will require VPC/KMS for the PoC or if a Hosted baseline is acceptable to start.
- Clara: share any procurement timing constraints and the primary procurement contact (I added procurement@ in case).
- Redwood: we will share a filled PoC Success Criteria template and a rough resource plan once you confirm preferred path.

Attaching the PoC_Success_Criteria_Template.xlsx for your edits.

Thanks again — happy to hop back on a 30 minute sync if that helps move decisions faster.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0183

Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PoC deployment pathing: hosted vs dedicated vs private VPC — action plan and next steps

Thanks Laura — great summary and helpful checklist. A few clarifications from our side: 

- We are leaning toward Private VPC for the PoC because our legal team flagged that PHI can not traverse shared tenancy in our current risk posture. That said, we'd like the Hosted baseline first if Redwood can guarantee that no persistent logs will be retained and that any demo data is fully scrubbed.
- Procurement timeline: we aim to have MSA + SOW approved within 3 weeks if tech signoff is in place. I added procurement@nimblehealth.com to loop them in.
- Security asks: can you provide SOC 2 Type II report and a short KMS/HSM integration note? Our infra security will also want to see network architecture and firewall rules for Private VPC.

I've attached our internal security stack and list of compliance questions — labeled Nimble_Security_Requirements_2027.pdf.

If acceptable, proposed kickoff week for PoC (baseline + scoping) would be the week of 21 Jun 2027.

Clara
Clara Wu
Director, Platform Engineering | Nimble Health
clara.wu@nimblehealth.com

Attachments: Nimble_Security_Requirements_2027.pdf

- Rishi: please review the attached Nimble_Security_Requirements_2027.pdf and advise on the estimated effort for a Private VPC PoC (network, KMS/HSM, certs). Ballpark: can you provide a 4–6 week estimate and list of prerequisites?
- Stephanie: procurement expects MSA + SOW within ~3 weeks after tech signoff — can you prepare a draft SOW template and pricing placeholder for a Private VPC PoC (include Dedicated option pricing too)?

I want to keep the scope tight: baseline hosted for model evaluation, security scoping concurrently, and a clear cutover checklist for Private VPC if needed.

Thanks — I will coordinate a short internal pre-call tomorrow to align owners.

Laura
